title: High Copse: room to grow.
text: In November 2026 the University of Reading agreed in principle to include Cowherds Field and land north of the bus lane at High Copse, opening the way to much more sports space and a full-size 3G pitch. As Facilities Chair, Brett has led the talks with the University, the Football Foundation and Berks & Bucks FA. The council has also agreed a 58-year lease of the High Copse sports facility with the University of Reading.
statusText: Agreed in principle. Legal documents, planning and funding still to come.
source: Facilities Committee chronological record (public record); lease between the University of Reading and Shinfield Parish Council

title: Padel: shaped by what you told us.
text: Brett led the residents' consultation on padel courts: 307 responses, with 94% in support. A noise assessment came back positive, and the University has given permission to progress planning.
statusText: Next step is a planning pre-application and the initial design. No planning application has been decided yet.

title: A cycling area for young people at The Manor.
text: Brett took an informal youth cycling and BMX idea to the University of Reading, which agreed a temporary licence for part of the field at The Manor. The area is in use, and an extension to June 2027 has been agreed in principle.
statusText: In use. The extension is subject to legal documents.

title: Cricket at High Copse, chosen fairly.
text: After four presentations and three tenders, the Facilities Committee unanimously chose Shinfield Cricket Club for High Copse in April 2026. Brett seconded the decision.
statusText: Agreed. Heads of terms to follow.
source: Facilities Committee chronological record (public record), April 2026

title: Tennis at Millworth Lane.
text: Brett has helped negotiate heads of terms with Shinfield Tennis Club for Millworth Lane.

title: Goals on the community pitch.
text: Goals for the council's free community pitch at High Copse, with permanent fencing and security improvements following in 2026.
